services.title: Stage Decoration
services.subtitle: The majestic focal point of your event
services.description: Grand floral backdrops, architectural tiered podiums, bespoke velvet drapery, romantic crystal chandeliers, and customized ambient spotlighting tailored to your royal aesthetic.

services.title: Floral Design & Centerpieces
services.subtitle: Lush botanical artistry with intoxicating fragrance
services.description: Imported Ecuadorian garden roses, delicate cascading white orchids, local Ethiopian highland blooms, and bespoke tablescapes curated in brushed gold and crystal vases.

services.title: Venue Decoration & Draping
services.subtitle: Complete metamorphosis of raw spaces into fairy tales
services.description: Floor-to-ceiling silk ceiling swags, ballroom acoustic velvet perimeter draping, seamless high-gloss mirrored aisle runners, and synchronized perimeter uplighting.

services.title: Table & Chair Styling
services.subtitle: Impeccable tablescapes worthy of state banquets
services.description: Custom textured table linens, beaded glass charger plates, brushed champagne gold flatware, crystal stemware, letterpress calligraphy menus, and curated Chiavari seating.

services.title: Grand Entrance & Arches
services.subtitle: A breathless first impression as guests arrive
services.description: Monumental floral triumphal arches, mirrored welcome easels with gilded calligraphy, hurricane lanterns with flickering candlelight, and rose petal runways.

services.title: Photo Backdrops & Media Walls
services.subtitle: Picture-perfect memory spaces for eternal keepsakes
services.description: Dimensional 3D living floral walls, warm neon custom monograms, modern arch geometries, and soft studio-grade ring lighting for flawless photography.

services.title: Architectural & Ambient Lighting
services.subtitle: Painting with luminescence and romantic shadows
services.description: Warm amber pin-spotting for floral centerpieces, crystal chandelier clusters, ethereal starry ceiling fairy canopies, and programmed mood lighting.

services.title: Custom & Cultural Installations
services.subtitle: Honoring heritage with modern couture sophistication
services.description: Bespoke Ethiopian Melse ceremony canopies, traditional woven accents infused with contemporary gold filigree, royal seating, and customized structural carpentry.

gallery.title: Sarah & Michael — Lakeside Royal Wedding
gallery.description: A breathtaking royal wedding celebration featuring a majestic 10-meter white and blush rose stage, crystal pendant chandeliers, candle-lined mirrored walkway, and lavish floral centerpieces overlooking Lake Hawassa.
gallery.testimonialQuote: Mekdi Decor made our wedding day truly magical. The transformation of Skyline Hall was beyond what we ever dreamed possible.

gallery.title: Dr. Helen Girma — Golden Honors Gala
gallery.description: A prestigious honors celebration draped in deep emerald green, champagne gold accents, monumental acrylic lettering, warm halo uplighting, and dramatic geometric centerpiece towers.
gallery.testimonialQuote: Every single guest was mesmerized the moment they stepped inside the ballroom. Mekdi’s team operates at world-class standards.

gallery.title: Blen & Dawit — Lakeside Sunset Engagement
gallery.description: An open-air waterfront sanctuary adorned with fragrant cascading garden roses, hanging fairy light curtains, brushed gold lanterns, and a floral arch positioned right over the reflecting lake.
gallery.testimonialQuote: The candlelight and floral scent as the sun set over Lake Kuriftu brought tears to our eyes. Pure romance.

gallery.title: Selamawit — 30th Velvet & Gold Birthday Soirée
gallery.description: Sensational crimson and gold styling with a personalized illuminated neon sign, cascading champagne flute tower, velvet lounge seating, and dramatic spotlight accents.
gallery.testimonialQuote: The most chic and stylish birthday celebration in Adama! Mekdi took care of everything so flawlessly.

gallery.title: East Africa Fintech Gala — Grand Skylight
gallery.description: State-of-the-art stage architecture with integrated LED screens, brushed steel and gold geometric centerpieces, branded entrance media tunnel, and banquet seating for 500 delegates.
gallery.testimonialQuote: Flawless execution under tight conference deadlines. The branding and aesthetic prestige exceeded our board expectations.

gallery.title: Kalkidan & Eyob — Royal Melse Celebration
gallery.description: An exquisite fusion of Ethiopian imperial heritage with modern luxury: custom Tilfi patterned drapery, golden Mesob pedestals, royal red carpets, and lush white and crimson roses.
gallery.testimonialQuote: Our Melse was authentic yet modern and royal. Everyone was talking about how elegant the Tilfi motifs and flowers looked.
